source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
When an enemy unit finishes a move 8" or less from this unit, this unit may use this ability if it is **[unengaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** or that enemy unit ended the move **engaged** with it. If it does, roll 1 D6: a 3+ inflicts 1 **[mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** on that enemy unit.

Track uses with tokens: put 1 Drakolithe token beside the unit per Drakolithe it carries, and take 1 away with every use.

engagementGate: moving enemy ended engaged with owning unit
